title: Energy conditions of bouncing solutions in quadratic curvature gravity coupled with a scalar field
summary: We examine the validity of classical energy conditions in nonsingular bouncing cosmological solutions arising in quadratic curvature gravity minimally coupled to a scalar field. Focusing on the null, weak, strong, and dominant energy conditions, we perform a systematic analysis under two distinct formulations of the energy-momentum tensor.
